# Environments 

- [ ] An environment is a list.
- [ ] Users cannot create objects  of mode `environment`
- [ ] To get the objects accessible in a given environment, call `ls()`


# Expressions  (`base::expression`, etc)

In `R` an object of type `expression` is 

- [ ] a string satisfying some syntactic properties
- [ ] an abstract syntax tree (AST)
- [ ] an object than can be fed to `eval()`
- [ ] an object with `mode` `expression`
- [ ] an object with `class` `expression`
- [ ] an object that passes test `is.expression()`?
